fusions.name: Shoal Wake
fusions.desc: Sends a jet of river water into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles (max 32%).

fusions.name: Ford Crossing
fusions.desc: Drives a cone of river water 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in it, knocking each back 3 tiles and leaving it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slippery Bulk
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 15 seconds. It also pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Silvered Scales
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. It also hardens your armour by 6% at all times.
